name: Operations
description: Support requests, error capture, a log table with search, events with daily totals and health checks with alerts for a product, in one package over the SQL storage adapter, its tables under a prefix of their own.

extensions.description: Support requests, error capture, log search, events with daily totals and health checks over the product's storage adapter

features: One package: support requests, error capture, a log table with search, an events table with daily totals and health checks with alerts, over the storage adapter the product passes, under a table prefix of its own

Help in the app: a signed-in person opens a request, writes with the team in a thread, attaches pictures and sees replies arrive; an unread reply goes by mail after five minutes; a person deletes a request or exports them all as a zip
The staff side: five pages for Support, Errors, Logs, Analytics and Health behind the product's own staff roles, and a row of four counts for the home

Errors: every failure the server catches or misses and every failure in a visitor's browser, grouped by fingerprint with first and last seen, a count and a resolve or ignore; a message is kept only when it is one of the engine's own templates with its slots blanked
Logs: the lines the product already writes, checked against the keys it declares, kept 14 days and searched by kind, path, status, process and time
Internal analytics: the product's figures by day and by plan from sources it declares, with a funnel, retention by sign-up cohort and revenue against cost

Health: checks of every service, each job's last run, the queues' depths and the box's memory, disk and restarts; a failure on two samples mails the team; two small watchers mail when the site does not answer and are themselves watched
A one-page adoption guide in the README for the next product
